title: A variable that saves the outer value gives the same result as EARLIER
query: "RT Rows", VAR CurrentQuantity = Sales[Quantity] RETURN COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] <= CurrentQuantity ) ) )

source.quote: EARLIER is superseded by a careful usage of variables.
source.supports: the page shows the same result for the VAR version of its EARLIER query

derivation: CurrentQuantity is the quantity of the ADDCOLUMNS row, evaluated before FILTER opens its row context. Rows of Sales with a quantity up to it: 1 gives 3 (rows 1, 3, 7), 2 gives 5 (plus rows 2, 5), 3 gives 6 (plus row 6), 5 gives 7 (plus row 4).
